title: Are you a super kid?

before.predict: Look at the title. What can a super kid do?

text.title: The Super Kid Quiz
text.meta: Fun Kids Magazine · Quiz by Madina
paragraphs: Hi! I’m Madina, and I’m twelve. I live in Khiva. I can **swim** very well, but I can’t **sing**! What can you do? Do my quiz and find out. Count your “a” answers!
1. Can you swim? a) Yes, very well. b) No, I can’t. 2. Can you **cook** plov? a) Yes, I can. b) No, but I can make tea. 3. Can you sing a song in English? a) Yes, I can. b) No, I can’t.

4. Can you **draw** animals? a) Yes, I can draw cats and horses. b) Only a little. 5. Can you **dance** the lazgi? a) Yes, I can dance very well. b) No, I can’t. 6. Can you **speak** three languages? a) Yes, Uzbek, Russian and English! b) No, only two.

RESULTS. 5–6 “a” answers: Wow! You are a super kid. You can do a lot! 3–4 “a” answers: Great! You can do many things. 0–2 “a” answers: That’s OK! Everyone can learn. Ask a friend to help you. My friend Ali can’t swim, but he can draw very well!

tf: There are six questions in the quiz.
Question 5 is about the lazgi dance.

mcq.q: You have four “a” answers. What is your result?
